channel.title: The Oakland Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Oakland Press (theoaklandpress.com)

item.title: Justice Department lawsuit says UCLA failed to protect Jewish employees from hostility
item.description: The suit accuses UCLA of failing to discipline those who were involved in protests.

item.title: Watch live: President Donald Trump’s State of the Union speech
item.description: The address is likely to be a test run of the message Republicans will give to voters in November’s elections.

item.title: Taylor Decker set to return to Lions in 2026
item.description: Entering the NFL Scouting Combine, Detroit Lions offensive tackle Taylor Decker was a focal point of discussion.

item.title: Hughes’ OT goal for Team USA vs Canada in Olympic final averages 26M live viewers on NBC, Peacock
item.description: Jack Hughes’ overtime goal, which gave the United States its first Olympic gold medal in men’s hockey since 1980, drew an average audience of 26 million viewers on NBC and Peacock in the U.S., according to Nielsen’s Big Data + Panel ratings and Adobe Analytics digital data.

item.title: State of the Union offers Trump a chance to make the case for his foreign policy approach
item.description: He's making the case to Americans who are increasingly uneasy about his priorities.

item.title: No. 3 Michigan beats Minnesota 77-67, clinches at least share of 1st Big Ten title since 2021
item.description: Elliot Cadeau had 15 points and L.J. Cason scored 11 of his 14 points in the second half as No. 3 Michigan beat Minnesota 77-67 on Tuesday night to clinch at least a share of the Big Ten title for the first time in five years.

item.title: Trump honors National Guard members shot in Washington
item.description: Air Force Staff Sgt. Andrew Wolfe was presented the Purple Heart medal during Trump’s State of the Union.

item.title: Photo gallery from Stoney Creek at West Bloomfield in OAA Red girls basketball action
item.description: The Stoney Creek Cougars defeated West Bloomfield 37-35 in the game played on Tuesday at West Bloomfield. With the win, the Cougars earn at least a share of the OAA Red title.

item.title: Cougars put turmoil aside, edge West Bloomfield to claim share of OAA Red title
item.description: One day after their head coach was dismissed, the Stoney Creek Cougars gutted out a 37-35 win on West Bloomfield’s Senior Night to capture a share of the Oakland Activities Association Red Division crown, their first division title since winning the OAA White in 2021.

item.title: Army pilot wounded in Maduro raid gets Congressional Medal of Honor during Trump’s speech
item.description: Army Chief Warrant Officer 5 Eric Slover was the pilot of the helicopter that descended on the 'heavily protected military fortress.'
